column3: A DOLLHOUSE CUTAWAY illustration for 3D modellers, 3:2 landscape: an isometric three-quarter view from above of ONE place, with the near walls and the ceiling/roof cut away cleanly (cut faces shown as dark basalt section) so the whole interior architecture is readable: its true shape and proportions, ceiling form (dome / vault / cave / open sky), floor levels and steps, walkways, stairs and doorways in and out (label where they lead), water bodies and how water flows, the focal feature, lighting positions, and a few tiny human figures for scale; a thin 10 m scale bar and small clean English labels. Rich, specific, believable architecture in the art direction of the attached concept art — make it dynamic and interesting, not boxy. PLACE: the ARRIVAL HALL carved into the mountain foot: a tall cave hall (vault 9-16 m) with a timber facade on the south, the full-width glass LAVA WINDOW on the north wall with lava falls beyond, slipper cubby wall and reception by the west entrance, a warm stream crossing the hall under an arched bridge, a stone basin with a blossom tree, and the spiral stair + glass lift doorway in the NE corner.
